description:
Community safety reporting — anonymous ICE activity tracking I.C.E Out is an ad-free, open-source community safety tool for reporting Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity after it occurs. Built with privacy-first principles — no accounts, no tracking, no data sold.
  • Anonymous report submission (no personal data collected)
  • Community-sourced activity map with color-coded markers
  • Report types: raid, checkpoint, surveillance, patrol, transport, other
  • Know Your Rights resources & emergency contacts
  • ICE facility directory
  • OpenFreeMap vector tiles + Leaflet/MapLibre
  • Fully offline-capable (mock mode when backend unavailable)
  • Self-hostable Supabase backend — users can configure their own
  • Reports expire after 72 hours
  • Zero proprietary dependencies
  • No analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party SDKs
All reports are view-only observations logged after incidents occur. This app does not encourage physical interference with law enforcement operations.

Network usage: By default, the app connects to a community backend hosted by the developer (Supabase) to share crowd-sourced sighting reports. This can be changed to any self-hosted Supabase instance in the app's configuration. Typed addresses are geocoded via nominatim.openstreetmap.org. Map tiles are loaded from tiles.openfreemap.org. Facility location data is bundled with the app and never sent to any server.
